An earlier Keyring build enrolled it for private vetting under a different identity from the one you vet with here, and an agent can't change that, so the community would refuse every vouching token it draws. Its enrolment here is stuck and won't clear by reopening the desk, and any tokens it holds for this community can't be used. To vouch privately here, connect a different agent.

CreateAgent.IntroBody: Your agent lives with a service that hosts it and keeps it online when your phone is off, much like an email provider. You can also run your own. Keep Keyring open while you set it up.
CreateAgent.IntroStep1: 1. Create your agent with the service that hosts it
CreateAgent.IntroStep3: 3. Add this phone's owner code to your agent

CreateAgent.NotAnAddress: That isn't an agent's address. It starts with did:webvh: — copy the whole line your agent's host shows.
CreateAgent.NoAgentThere: Keyring couldn't find an agent at that address. Check you copied the whole line, and that your agent has finished being created.
CreateAgent.OwnerBody: This code tells your agent that this phone owns it. The code is protected by {{method}}.
CreateAgent.AsDeviceBody: This phone has no screen lock, so it joins your agent as a device, not as its owner. To make it the owner, turn on a screen lock and link it again.

CreateAgent.ConfirmReason: Set up your new agent with this phone
CreateAgent.NotConfirmed: Keyring couldn't confirm it's you. Try again, or use your passcode.

CreateAgent.BackupLater: You can add another device later from My devices.
CreateAgent.ReadyBody: {{label}} is online and belongs to this phone.

CreateAgent.BackupNowScan: Now add the other device's code
